workspace.title: Single sign-on

errors.SSO_CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND: This single sign-on connection does not exist anymore.

page.title: Single sign-on
page.subtitle: Let your staff sign in with your organization's identity provider instead of an iCASCO password.
page.emptyHint: Choose your identity provider to start. You can test everything before staff use it.
page.loadError: Single sign-on settings could not be loaded.
page.how1: Create a connection and give the values shown to your identity provider.
page.how2: Add your email domains and prove ownership with a DNS TXT record.
page.how3: Test the connection, then enable it. Staff choose Continue with SSO on the sign-in page.
page.how4: Optional: create users on first sign-in and require single sign-on for everyone.

card.deleteBody: People on its domains will sign in with a password again. Accounts created by single sign-on stay in iCASCO.

wizard.name: Connection name
wizard.protocolLocked: The provider cannot change after the connection is created.
wizard.pasteTitle: Give these values to your identity provider
wizard.pasteHintOidc: Register iCASCO as a web application and add this redirect URI.
wizard.pasteHintSaml: Create a SAML application with these values. Use the email address as NameID and sign the assertion.
wizard.secretStored: A secret is stored and never shown again. Leave empty to keep it.
wizard.metadataHint: Paste the metadata URL or XML: iCASCO reads the sign-in URL and certificate from it.

guide.entra1: Entra admin center: App registrations, New registration, platform Web, paste the redirect URI.
guide.entra2: Certificates and secrets: create a client secret and paste it here.
guide.entra3: Token configuration: add the optional claim email; add a groups claim to use group rules.
guide.entra4: Issuer URL: https://login.microsoftonline.com/your tenant ID/v2.0. Client ID: the Application (client) ID.
guide.google1: Google Cloud console: OAuth consent screen, user type Internal.
guide.google2: Credentials: create an OAuth client ID of type Web application and paste the redirect URI.
guide.google3: Paste the client ID and client secret here. The issuer is filled in for you.
guide.google4: Google does not send groups: use the role for new users instead of group rules.
guide.okta1: Okta admin console: Applications, Create App Integration, OIDC, Web Application.
guide.okta2: Sign-in redirect URI: paste the redirect URI. Initiate login URI: paste the sign-on URL.
guide.okta3: Issuer URL: https://your-org.okta.com, or your authorization server such as /oauth2/default.
guide.okta4: Add a groups claim to the ID token to use group rules.
guide.generic_oidc1: Register a confidential web client with the authorization code flow and PKCE.
guide.generic_oidc2: Allow the redirect URI shown above.
guide.generic_oidc3: Paste the issuer URL (iCASCO reads its discovery document), client ID and secret.
guide.generic_oidc4: Send the email claim; send groups to use group rules.
guide.generic_saml1: Create a SAML 2.0 application with the reply URL and identifier shown above.
guide.generic_saml2: NameID: the email address. Sign the assertion with SHA-256; do not encrypt it.
guide.generic_saml3: Send email, name and groups attributes (the names can be changed under Users and roles).
guide.generic_saml4: Paste the IdP metadata URL or XML here, or type the sign-in URL and certificate.

wizard.domainsHint: Add the email domains of your staff, publish the TXT record in your DNS, then select Verify. Only verified domains can sign in.
wizard.domainInvalid: Enter a domain such as company.com.
wizard.domainPublic: Public mailbox domains such as gmail.com cannot be used.
wizard.domainDuplicate: This domain is already in the list.
wizard.unsavedDomains: Save the domain list to get its TXT records.
wizard.attrHint: Names of the claims or attributes your identity provider sends. Leave the defaults unless your provider uses other names.
wizard.jitHint: New people from verified domains get an iCASCO account and take one user seat of your plan.
wizard.noAccess: No access unless a group rule matches
wizard.rulesHint: The first matching group wins. When rules exist, people in none of the groups cannot sign in.
wizard.statusHint: Staff can use Continue with SSO only while the connection is enabled.
wizard.requireHint: Password sign-in is turned off for your users on the verified domains.
wizard.breakGlassHint: This CAB administrator can still sign in with a password if the identity provider is unavailable.
wizard.requireNeedsDomain: Verify at least one domain first.
wizard.requireWarning: Make sure a test sign-in succeeded before you require single sign-on.

test.title: Test connection
test.hint: Opens your identity provider in a small window and shows what it sends. No iCASCO session is created.
test.popupBlocked: Allow pop-ups for iCASCO to run the test.
test.none: No test yet. Run one before enabling the connection.
test.name: Name
test.wouldProvision: Would be created on first sign-in
